Description: All quantum circuits were simulated exactly on a CPU; no noise model and no quantum hardware.
Finite-shot kernels were evaluated only for the validation-selected 8×8 FRQI/NEQR and ZZ-full QKC configurations.
FRQI/NEQR were limited to 16×16 because simulated circuit depth grows to ~10⁵ compiled gates.
Locked test = NEU validation folder; validation (train-folder) scores exceed test scores for all models.
NEQR gate counts vary with pixel values; means over 5 sample images are reported.
Reconstruction metrics use 30 training images (5 per class).
Per-seed McNemar p-values are not corrected for multiple comparisons.
Hybrid gains come from classical MobileNetV3 features; quantum and classical classifiers on the same features perform similarly.
The product-RY kernel is classically computable in closed form.
